name: MLLT3 super elongation complex subunit

function.text: MLLT3 encodes protein AF-9. Annotated molecular activities include molecular adaptor activity and histone H3K18ac reader activity. It participates in regulation of chromatin organization and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Melanoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
